app.name: Reclaim
_: Reclaim's voice, keyed screen.element, bundled with the app. Every line here was written against the rules in CLAUDE.md: zero setup, the Caregiver voice, and the knowledge test (what does the app actually know, and when did it learn it). Never show what was missed. Never compare people. Never name someone who hasn't acted.
home.headline: Ready when you are.
home.body: Put your phone in the box. That's all there is to it.
home.week.label: This week
home.kept.none: Nothing here yet. It keeps every evening, from the first.
pair.headline: Meet your box.
pair.body: Hold your phone to the tag in any slot, or point your camera at the code on the box. That's the only setup there is.
home.footer.none: This week starts whenever you do.
session.out: This evening ends when your phone comes out of the box.
starttap.banner.title: Docked at {place}
end.evenings.label: Your evenings
end.evenings.none: The first is still to come.
end.evenings.body: Tonight's is the newest. They don't go away.
end.evenings.again: Today had already counted. An evening is a day, however many times you set it down.
end.short: An evening counts from fifteen minutes. This one is kept all the same.
autoclosed.headline: We closed this one for you.
autoclosed.body: Your phone went into the box at {time} and we never heard it come out. We've counted three hours and stopped there rather than guess.
autoclosed.counts: It still counts toward last night.
autoclosed.remove: That wasn't a real one — remove it
settings.title: Settings
settings.box.label: Your box
settings.forget.body: This phone stops being the box's. The box keeps everything; read its tag or code again to come back.
settings.nudge.title: One nudge an evening
settings.how.label: How it works
settings.how.1: An evening counts from fifteen minutes in the box.
settings.how.2: Take your phone out and it ends, fifteen seconds later.
settings.how.3: Left in overnight, it closes at three hours and counts there.
settings.see.label: What we can see
settings.see.body: When your phone is in the box, and how many of you were. Nothing about your screen, the apps you opened, or where you were.
places.somewhere.title: Somewhere
error.retry: That didn't take. Try it again?
unreachable.headline: Not connected yet.
unreachable.body: The first time, this needs the internet for a moment. There's nothing else to set up.
